title: feat(i18n): translate sort/filter builders and view menus
body:
## What

Closes the remaining hardcoded-English gaps in the **sort panel**, **filter panel**, the **view tab menus**, and the **Manage Views dialog** (reported with screenshots showing English in an otherwise-localized console).

### Before → after (now driven by i18n with English fallback)
- **Sort builder**: `Sort by` / `Then by` / `Select field` / `A → Z` / `Z → A` / `Add sort`
- **Filter builder**: `Where` / `AND`·`OR` / `Clear all` / `Select field` / operator picker (all 15 operators) / `Select value` / `Add filter` / lookup picker search & empty states
- **View tab bar** (chevron dropdown + right-click context menu + overflow): `Edit view config` / `Rename` / `Duplicate` / `Set as default` / `Pin·Unpin view` / `Change view type` / `Delete view` / `Manage all views…` / `N more`
- **Manage Views dialog**: title/description, search placeholder, empty state, row menus, pin/default/drag aria labels, footer buttons

## How
- New top-level namespaces **`filterBuilder`** and **`sortBuilder`** (incl. `operators.*`), plus **`view.editViewConfig`**, **`view.manageViewsDescription`**, **`view.defaultBadge`**, added to **all 10 built-in locales** (en, zh, ja, ko, de, fr, es, pt, ru, ar). Top-level + `common` key parity preserved.
- `sort-builder.tsx` / `filter-builder.tsx` use `createSafeTranslation` (resilient outside an `I18nProvider`). Operator text renders from `filterBuilder.operators.<value>`; the English `label` in `defaultOperators` stays as the fallback.
- `ViewTabBar.tsx` and `ManageViewsDialog.tsx` use the `useObjectTranslation` fallback helper (key missing / no provider → English).

## Test
- `@object-ui/i18n` suite green (40/40, incl. locale top-level + `common` parity).
- `@object-ui/i18n` type-check, `@object-ui/components` build, `@object-ui/plugin-view` build all pass.
- No test asserted on the changed literal strings.
